description: Runtime borrow tracking, range splitting and finite token identities

expected.contract: A writer[0,8) blocks a reader[3,4). Splitting it at3 creates[0,3) and[3,8), invalidates the parent token and admits no gap or overlap. A writer[8,8) may coexist because it touches no element. A released token cannot release a later loan in the same slot.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
